pages.text:
ptA said this. that when a thing is given to you
you carry it like a coat someone else's
shoulders
have already made room in. it hangs wrong.
but the thing you find - even if it's the same
coat, the same wool, the same
missing button -

fits. because the finding is
part of the shape of it.

I said: so we're just describing
possession. she said no.
we're describing *authorship*
I said: but I didn't author the coat.
she said: no. but you authored
the wearing.

and I've been sitting with that for
three days now, and I don't know
if it's wisdom or if it's just
a thing that sounds like wisdom
when you say it slowly enough.
